invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of a collect operation, which never returns null.
If the result is empty, it is because the input list smallFiles is empty.
Each element in smallFiles produces exactly one String in the result.
Each fileId is obtained from smallFile.location.getFileId(), which is expected to be non-null for valid locations.
The number of distinct file IDs is at most the total number of file IDs returned.
